name: tandem-lite
description: A local-first VS Code agent for approved developer and desktop tasks on Windows and macOS.
author: PQR LLC

developerAgent.model.model.description: Legacy planner-model setting. Prefer Developer Agent: Planner Model for new configurations.

developerAgent.model.planner.description: Text model used to create plans. Recommended: qwen3:4b. Faster/lighter: qwen3:1.7b. More capable local option: qwen3.5:4b.

developerAgent.model.visionFallback.description: Vision model reserved for screenshot-based UI fallback. Recommended: qwen3-vl:4b-instruct. This setting takes effect once visual observation is enabled.

developerAgent.model.statusModel.description: Small local model used asynchronously for short status and activity descriptions. Set to an empty string to use built-in wording only.

developerAgent.model.planningTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for the planner model before using the deterministic fallback plan. 30,000 ms is recommended for a cold local qwen3:4b request.

developerAgent.model.endpoint.description: Provider endpoint. API keys are stored in SecretStorage.

developerAgent.providers.ollama.model.description: Ollama planner model. Used whenever Developer Agent: Model Provider is ollama.

developerAgent.providers.ollama.endpoint.description: Ollama API endpoint. Used whenever the Ollama provider is selected.

developerAgent.providers.openai.model.description: OpenAI planner model. Used whenever Developer Agent: Model Provider is openai.

developerAgent.providers.openai.endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible API endpoint. Used whenever the OpenAI provider is selected.

developerAgent.providers.anthropic.model.description: Anthropic planner model. Used whenever the Anthropic provider is selected.

developerAgent.providers.anthropic.endpo.description: Anthropic API endpoint. Used whenever the Anthropic provider is selected.

developerAgent.providers.openai-compatib.description: OpenAI-compatible planner model. Used whenever that provider is selected.
OpenAI-compatible API endpoint. Used whenever that provider is selected.

developerAgent.permissions.windows.description: Policy for opening applications, files, or folders through the operating system.

developerAgent.permissions.fileScan.description: Policy for scanning directories outside the workspace.

developerAgent.permissions.desktopContro.description: Policy for focusing/closing windows and interacting with accessible desktop controls.

developerAgent.execution.timeoutMs.description: Maximum execution time for a single approved plan. Full-drive file scans may take several minutes.
